general_information.name: OH—FULL LEGAL NAME, RIGHT. IT’S ROBERT MILLER.

current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly it’s been this loss of interest, and I’ve been so fatigued… I’m not as social as I used to be, and sleep has become a bit of a nuisance too.
current_concerns.goals: Well, I’d like to enjoy life again, and keep active if I can.

medications.current_medications:
Medication 1: Name Or Description: Carbidopa-levodopa.; Dose: It’s the 25/100 mg tablets… one tablet, three times a day.; Start Or Duration: Started in 2024.; Side Effects: Occasional nausea.
Medication 2: Name Or Description: Yes… latanoprost eye drops.; Dose: One drop in each eye nightly.; Start Or Duration: Started in 2021.; Side Effects: None known.
Medication 3: Name Or Description: Yes, one more: allopurinol.; Dose: 100 mg daily.; Start Or Duration: Started in 2019.; Side Effects: None known.

medical_history.medical_conditions: Oh… there are a few, but let me think. Parkinson’s disease is one. And then there’s glaucoma, and gout—those are the ones I remember offhand.

family_psychiatric_history.family_psychiatric_history_details: Family member 1: Name Or Description: My granddaughter.; Diagnosis Or Condition: ADHD.; Additional Details: Diagnosed at age 9.

substance_use.nonmedical_alcohol_use: Status: Current; Substance or product: Wine.; Quantity or frequency: Monthly… minimal, just a little.; Duration: I don’t know.

education_employment_legal_history.highest_education: Bachelor’s degree… teacher, I think that’s the way it would be put.
education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Job 1: Name Or Description: Oakville District School Board.; Job Title: High school science teacher.; Dates: 1978 to 2013.

personal_history.early_childhood: Born, grew up… just sort of there, you know. I was born and grew up, not much more to say than that, really.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: School, mostly — and then I became a teacher. That’s the main thing I remember.
personal_history.significant_relationships: Married. It’s been 49 years, and my wife is supportive.
personal_history.future_goals: I’d like to enjoy life, and manage the illness.
